# Annual Financial Comparison and Outlook Assessment for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel

**Mixed**

NVDA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25 was $215.938 billion [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html), up from $130.497 billion for 2025-01-26 [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). NVDA net income for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25 was $120.067 billion [Eef3b5c67c4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html), up from $72.880 billion for 2025-01-26 [E3e123cecb5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2025 viewpoint, NVIDIA's latest annual filing for the fiscal period ended January 26, 2025 (filed on 2025-02-26) reported revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [Ed26891b1f6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). Advanced Micro Devices' latest annual filing for the period ended December 28, 2024 (filed on 2025-02-05) reported revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 [E7f0d407567](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [Ebc212f1281](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel Corporation's latest annual filing for the period ended December 28, 2024 (filed on 2025-01-31) reported revenue of $53,101,000,000 and operating income of -$11,678,000,000 [E0a7a8b131a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [E63b9df5055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). Management outlook passages filed around this timeframe included NVIDIA's expectation of increased capital expenditures in fiscal year 2026 [Eaae2ace40f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm), AMD's expectation of growth in AI deployment products [E7e32e434fa](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/amd-20241228.htm), and Intel's anticipation of achieving volume production on its Intel 18A node in 2025 [Ed517dd218b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/intc-20241228.htm).

## What happened later

Subsequent annual results filed through the November 7, 2026 outcome cutoff captured further operational shifts. For NVIDIA's fiscal year ended January 25, 2026 (filed on 2026-02-25), revenue reached $215,938,000,000 and operating income rose to $130,387,000,000 [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html) [Effb397ce53](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html). AMD reported for its fiscal year ended December 27, 2025 (filed on 2026-02-04) revenue of $34,639,000,000 and operating income of $3,694,000,000 [E99f77b20a8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html) [E9981b97b1c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html). Intel reported for its fiscal year ended December 27, 2025 (filed on 2026-01-23) revenue of $52,853,000,000 and an operating loss of -$2,214,000,000 [E523c845704](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html) [E48a74e5f9f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing the latest annual periods through the outcome cutoff, NVIDIA (fiscal year ended 2026-01-25) generated $215,938,000,000 in revenue and $130,387,000,000 in operating income [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html) [Effb397ce53](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html). AMD (fiscal year ended 2025-12-27) recorded $34,639,000,000 in revenue and $3,694,000,000 in operating income [E99f77b20a8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html) [E9981b97b1c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html). Intel (fiscal year ended 2025-12-27) posted $52,853,000,000 in revenue and an operating loss of -$2,214,000,000 [E523c845704](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html) [E48a74e5f9f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html). Fiscal calendars differ slightly among peers: NVIDIA operates on a retail calendar ending in late January, while AMD and Intel use late-December fiscal year-ends.

## Cross-examination

Certain qualitative forecasts in the filings cannot be verified using standard financial statement metrics alone. For instance, Intel's expectation to achieve volume production on its 2nm node (Intel 18A) in 2025 [Ed517dd218b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/intc-20241228.htm) is an operational milestone that does not map directly to standard XBRL revenue or operating income line items. Similarly, NVIDIA's anticipation of higher capital expenditures in fiscal year 2026 [Eaae2ace40f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm) involves managerial projections that lack separate segment-level verification under standard financial disclosures. Observers should distinguish broad directional revenue growth from specific operational and manufacturing targets.

## Limits

- Specific segment-level revenues for AI products are not broken out as separate XBRL tags, limiting direct testing of product-line forecasts.
- Management capital expenditure expectations were stated qualitatively without specific numeric targets.
